title: Frozen PoC out-of-domain evaluation on the 160 human labels
why: Measure the real OOD error rate of the frozen ensemble_v1 against the newly delivered 160 human labels (pre-registered test)
hypothesis: The IndEgo-trained frozen ensemble transfers weakly to Egocentric-10K
data: Egocentric-10K 160 windows, 47 factories, 138 good / 22 bad (labels/ood160_labels.json); frozen scores from caches/ensemble/ood_scores{,2}.json
method: frozen two-view ensemble_v1 as-is (no fitting/re-thresholding); AUROC + balanced accuracy with window bootstrap (optimistic) and factory-grouped bootstrap (honest)
summary: Frozen ensemble OOD AUROC 0.566 (window CI 0.433-0.693; factory-grouped 0.414-0.697), up from a noise-level 0.415 at n=60. Shipped operating point: accept 71 / review 35 / reject 54; BA 0.387 review=miss (0.546 scalar@0.5); it hard-rejects 47/138 good windows (34%) and rejects only 7/22 bad. Weak positive ranking signal, not separable from chance; unusable as a gate.
decision: OOD claims: replace 'at chance/inverted 0.415' with 'weak positive 0.566, not significant, bad operating point'; cascade 0.600 carried over from handover with no grouped CI.
